label: about me
title:
In web design since 2023:
a studio, freelance and 30+ projects

list.title: I run projects without chaos
list.text: 2019–2022 — project manager at Yandex: up to 10 projects a month, contracts, deadlines, calls. This experience helps me keep your project in clear stages and on schedule.

list.title: I match the style to the niche
list.text: Minimalism for businesses, doctors and lawyers. Brighter for psychologists, travel and creative projects.

list.title: How I like to communicate
list.text: My main channel is Telegram. To explain page logic, I record Loom screen walkthroughs. Calls on Zoom or Google Meet when we need to discuss strategy and plans for the site.

list.title: What clients value in me
list.text: I'm calm, with no drama and no deadline panic. I keep things structured and explain step by step what we're doing and why.

list.title: I live in Belgrade with my husband and our dog Kika
list.text: I love watching how old buildings, graffiti and new spaces mix here — it often inspires my design decisions.

list.title: I draw by hand, embroider and knit
list.text: I love drawing by hand, knitting and looking for creative solutions in everything: from a layout to how I present an idea to a client.
